Hootsuite describes itself as one place to create, approve, schedule and measure every post [2]. Its plans are Standard at $99, Professional at $199 and Advanced at $399 per user a month, billed annually, each with a free 14-day trial; Enterprise is priced on request [1]. Every plan runs on Wisdom, Hootsuite’s AI, which drafts captions, hashtags and post ideas, and you can generate posts and images with AI right in the app [1].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
